Hi Jill —

Thanks for the form and the context. I've routed this to our privacy operations and customer success teams. Next steps from Redwood:
- Monica (CC'd) will validate the conversation id against our audit store and confirm the exact list of affected artifacts (logs, KV cache entries, and any analytics rows).
- We will need an authorized sign-off via DocuSign (I see you attached the PDF; we may request an e-signature).
- Once authorized we will schedule a targeted sanitization job that removes the conversation from search/audit indexes and marks tokens as expunged in our compliance store.

ETA estimate: preliminary validation by EOD 2026-08-05, removal window within 3 business days after authorization (subject to maintenance windows). If you need a faster SLA we can discuss exception routing with Legal.

I'll follow up with Monica's findings separately.

—Stephanie
Stephanie Nguyen
Account Executive, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>

Subject: Re: Request to remove single conversation from logs (internal RID: CHK1584)

Jill / Stephanie —

I validated the CSV snippet against our audit index. Confirmed matches:
- conversation_id: conv_20260512_ACME_77ab
- first_seen: 2026-05-12T14:08:33Z
- last_seen: 2026-05-12T14:15:04Z

Artifacts identified for removal:
1) Audit events (audit_logs table) — 4 rows
2) Search index entries (conversation metadata) — 1 index document
3) Transient cache (KV cache) — cache keys evicted
4) Cost/usage analytics rows (aggregates) — flagged for redaction (we keep totals but remove conversation-level detail)

Attached is an export of the 4 audit rows (audit_log_snippet.csv).
Requirements from Acme to proceed:
- DocuSign authorization from an Approved Signer on your side (we cannot act without signed authorization)
- Confirmation that CHK1584 is the only conversation to target

Planned timeline after signed authorization: targeted sanitization job runs during our low-traffic window (02:00–04:00 PT). Job completes in ~45 minutes; we'll send a signed attestation of removal and the job ID.

Marcus, tagging you for legal sign-off on the attestation language and any exceptions.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference

Jill —

Legal has reviewed the completed deletion_request_form and the audit snippet. We're comfortable proceeding with the targeted sanitization under the standard attestation wording. A few small notes:
- Please confirm the Authorized Signer who will e-sign (name + title) so the DocuSign envelope can be routed correctly.
- We will retain a high-level record of the action (date, job ID, request ID CHK1584) for compliance reporting but that record will not contain conversation content or identifiers after the redaction completes.

Once you send the signed envelope we will schedule the job for the next low-traffic window and email you the job tracking id and signed attestation within 24 hours.

Thanks — looking forward to your confirmation.

Marcus Lin
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
